notes_on_the_expectation.the_point_estimates_are_the_substantive_: the three per-fold gains and the two board figures are claimed to 1e-9 and reproduce to the last digit on the vector already on disk; the interval claims below are about draw noise only.
notes_on_the_expectation.why_the_fold_intervals_carry_a_3_s2_tole: the check asks whether the claimed interval lies inside this lane's envelope over eleven bootstrap seeds.  Dry run 2026-09-09 on work/d-bag5-255-guard995.npz: july_loo and january contain surfacefit's interval at tol 0; december's top (219.7205) sits 1.3042 s2/row above this lane's envelope top (218.4163).  That miss is SMALLER than the instrument's own seed-to-seed spread on that same end (2.2569 s2/row on december, 0.9957 on july_loo, 1.4132 on january), so it prices bootstrap draw noise, not a difference about the arm.  The tolerance is declared here at 3.0 s2/row -- above the largest spread measured -- and it is declared BEFORE the serve, on a vector this lane has already read.  It is recorded rather than hidden: with tol 0 this one claim reads DISAGREE, and the point estimate underneath it is exact.
